Bottom line: Focus on risk management for your leveraged, underperforming positions amidst a challenging macro backdrop for tech.
plays: Review SOXL (-52.13%) and SPAL (-30.89%) stops immediately. Given their leveraged nature and deep losses, consider cutting these positions to preserve capital.
